text: FAA guidance: when a link is lost, reestablish the control link and, if that fails, initiate contingency procedures for loss of control and follow pre-determined procedures for loss of VLOS. FAA guidance also permits landing immediately, hovering, or employing a return‑to‑home sequence depending on capabilities. DJI Matrice 4T manual: if GNSS is unavailable at takeoff, the aircraft will approximately follow the outbound trajectory back to the vicinity of the home point; on signal loss it auto‑initiates RTH if the RTH action is set; and if the RTH distance is 5–50 m, it orients and flies straight horizontally back to the home point at the current altitude.
